purpose: Dated, machine-readable evidence for the repository security assurance baseline (#92618 §6). Rows are attributable to exact objects, not branch names; unknown stays first-class. SECURITY.md remains authoritative for the security boundary; nothing here is a compliance or certification claim.

controls.claim: OSV advisory scanning runs on every pull request and on a weekly schedule
controls.scope: linux x86_64 GitHub-hosted CI, uv-resolved dependency graph at reviewed head

controls.claim: uv lockfile integrity is checked on every pull request
controls.scope: uv.lock and dependency-source policy for the default workspace

controls.claim: Large binary and large new-file additions are rejected at CI
SECURITY.md states the OS-level isolation boundary and coordinated-disclosure scope
controls.standard: NIST CSF 2.0 GV.SC / OWASP WSTG threat modeling
controls.scope: policy source at reviewed head; policy-source check only, not an architecture audit

controls.claim: Prompt-injection and promptware pattern regressions are covered by a dedicated test suite
controls.standard: OWASP Agentic AI Threats and Mitigations / MITRE ATLAS
controls.scope: in-process pattern scanning for tool results, memory writes and skill installs

controls.claim: The evidence ledger itself is consumed by a gate that fails on required failed, missing, stale or unknown evidence
controls.scope: this ledger, evaluated against the reviewed head

controls.surface: secrets and credential material in tree and release inputs
controls.claim: Secret scanning across the current tree and release inputs
controls.owner: repository maintainers (pending: no dedicated secret-scanning workflow in-tree)
controls.scope: gap recorded honestly: GitHub secret scanning may be enabled on the repository, but no in-tree workflow or test witness exists yet

controls.claim: Independent penetration testing and retest protocol before a high-risk release
controls.owner: repository maintainers (pending: no independent pentest receipt recorded)
controls.scope: gap recorded honestly: cadence, scope and retest closure protocol are not yet established

controls.claim: Published artifacts are traceable to exact reviewed source and verified dependency state (digest-matched provenance)
controls.owner: repository maintainers (pending: no signed provenance attestation recorded)
controls.scope: gap recorded honestly: releases are not yet published with inspectable attestation receipts

controls.claim: Deployment-assurance interlock consuming this evidence at admission, promotion, recovery and history
controls.justification: Managed-SSH rollout is not implemented; #118029 owns admission/promotion/recovery and its applicable evidence is part of that deployment acceptance, not this repository gate.
controls.scope: managed installations only; not applicable to local/manual installs
